en: Dependent on a state that is non-conflict (*anaraṇa*) and without an object (*anārammaṇa*), a state that is non-conflict and with an object arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. One [condition] under root; ... pe ... one under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is non-conflict and without an object, a state that is non-conflict and without an object arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is non-conflict and without an object, a state that is non-conflict and without an object arises by way of root condition.
(Concise. Two in the case of root; two in the case of predominance … pe … one in the case of result … pe … two in the case of non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is neither without-conflict nor mental, a state that is without-conflict and mental arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither without-conflict nor mental, a state that is with-conflict and mental arises by way of root condition. (Concise.)
Under the condition of cause (hetu), there are two; ... pe ... under the condition of result (vipāka), there is one; ... pe ... under the condition of non-disappearance (avigata), there are two.
Dependent on a state that is neither conflict (na-araṇa) nor mental (na-cetasika), a mental state that is conflict arises by way of the condition of cause.
Dependent on a state that is neither conflict nor mental, a mental state that is conflict arises by way of the condition of cause.
(Abbreviated. Two in the case of root-cause … pe … one in the case of result … pe … two in the case of non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is neither-conflict nor mind-associated, a state that is conflict-free and mind-associated arises by way of root-cause condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither-conflict nor mind-associated, a state that is with-conflict and mind-associated [arises] … pe … [and so on].
...arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are two; ...pe... under the non-disappearance condition there are two.
Dependent on a state that is neither with-conflict nor mind-associated, a state that is without-conflict and mind-associated arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither without-conflict nor mind-associated, a state that is with-conflict and mind-associated [arises].
It arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are two; ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition there are two.
